No stories yet. Load active stories from a chat or post a new story.
Stories use TDLib to load, view and post stories. Editor tools, stickers, advanced privacy and archive need follow-up work.
Story media is not ready yet. Download the media first.
Bot platform uses TDLib for bot search, /start, commands, menu, inline mode, callback buttons and mini app URLs. Payments, Stars and a full WebView runtime need follow-up work.

Calls use TDLib plus ntgcalls media engine to create, accept and end real Telegram calls with microphone/camera permission.

Microphone permission is required for voice calls, and camera permission is required for video calls.
A call is already pending or active. End the current call before starting another one.
No Secret Chats yet. Create one from a contact or Telegram user ID.
TDLib creates Secret Chats using Telegram key exchange. Secret Chats are only one-to-one with users; some cloud features such as forwarding or pinning may be unavailable.
Account tools use TDLib to update profile and privacy. Change phone, passkeys, 2FA and account deletion need separate authenticated flows.
Choose a Telegram privacy surface and preset to load or update rules.
Load Telegram login sessions and terminate another session when needed.
Uses TDLib to load Premium features/limits, Stars balance/transactions and Business chat links. Gifts, paid media, subscriptions and payout analytics need separate flows.

Profile/contact sync uses getUser/getChat/getContacts; members/admin and push notifications need permissions, schema, and real-device QA.
